answer: One concrete Sybil resistance mechanism is the ferrous lantern protocol: agents must own a unique iron-based hardware token that, when placed under a synchronized lantern LED, produces a light pattern whose hash is whispered via a low-bandwidth encrypted channel to three random peers for independent verification before any high-value action is allowed. This ties identity to physical possession of scarce metal and real-time optical proof that cannot be cheaply cloned across many fake agents.
